title: Twill: Scheduling Compound AI Systems on Heterogeneous Mobile Edge Platforms
problem: Compound AI systems chain multiple models (DNNs, transformers, LLMs) on mobile edge platforms with dynamic workloads and heterogeneous computational demands, challenging existing scheduling methods.
method: Twill is a real-time scheduler for mobile devices with multiple processor types. It assigns model computations to the processor each one performs best on (task affinity), prioritizes critical work by pausing less important tasks when needed, and adjusts processor speed and voltage (Dynamic Voltage/Frequency Scaling, or DVFS) to reduce power consumption. These strategies minimize total execution time while respecting power budgets.
key_novelty: Twill is the first scheduler that manages multiple AI model types—deep neural networks, transformers, and large language models—running simultaneously on mobile devices with heterogeneous hardware.
contributions: Task affinity-aware cluster mapping and migration
54% average latency reduction on Jetson Orin NX
primary_theme: Run-time scheduling for compound AI systems on mobile platforms
